claim_one_line: PHASE A BANKED -- four leads closed, one new mechanism, and the same failure a third time. DISPOSITIONS: L134 CLOSED, not an independent gap, since <S> != 0 IS E6 -> SO(10), the same input at the same step as L133 and L138, so three leads collapse to ONE OPERATION USED THREE TIMES; L132 CLOSED VACUOUS (triply), reproducing B864 and independently flagged by the cell as 'a prior-art miss inside our own corpus', CORROBORATING B976 from a different direction without being told; L137 CLOSED REFUTED with no successor, and B947's pass/fail scoped as a property of a CHOSEN NORMALISATION of a cubic rather than of the locus it describes; L135 DISCHARGED for the rebuild (51/51, two fresh primes), blocked only on char-0 exactification over K, and it UNBLOCKS L142. V5, A NEW MECHANISM, RE-DERIVED HERE BY LATTICE MEMBERSHIP rather than accepted: omega_1 in the root basis is (4/3, 1, 5/3, 2, 4/3, 2/3), with 1*omega_1 and 2*omega_1 NOT in Q while 3*omega_1 IS, so class(27) has ORDER 3, hence 2*class(27) != 0, hence THE 78 DOES NOT OCCUR IN 27 x 27 -- therefore NO ADJOINT VEV CAN GIVE ANY 27 FERMION A MASS, since a Yukawa needs total centre charge 0 while a 27-bilinear carries 2*class(27) != 0 and the adjoint carries 0. THIS GIVES THE VERDICT'S HEADLINE A MECHANISM IT PREVIOUSLY LACKED: 'the object supplies the adjoint half and not the 27 half' was a statement about RANK and is now also a statement about MASS -- the adjoint half does gauge structure and provably CANNOT do matter mass -- and it is the SAME fact (omega_1 not in Q) that makes the 27 complex and that B960 used to close the adjoint-form hatch, a third role for one lattice fact. A SCOPING CORRECTION THE VERDICT NEEDS: the A2+A1 Levi does NOT label matter versus exotic, since 18 of 27 states change side across the three so(10)s above it, so 'the object supplies the adjoint half' must be scoped to THE PATH, NOT THE LANDING SITE -- the landing site alone does not distinguish a generation from the exotics. THE SAME FAILURE A THIRD TIME TODAY: the synthesis found that B958/B961's claim that the frame could not be rebuilt without the solo seat's definitions was FALSE -- the definitions were in CMT_DRAFT.md section 2 and B911 had ALREADY BUILT the frame, while I inspected B909 only. That makes THREE INSTANCES IN ONE DAY OF DECLARING ABSENT WHAT ALREADY EXISTED: B950 (the global Z6 form 'not addressed' -- B862 derives it), B976 (hypercharge 'OPEN, the sharpest target' -- B864 derived it), and B974 (the frame 'cannot be rebuilt' -- CMT_DRAFT had the definitions and B911 had built it). This is exactly the class representation-sweep (B977) was built for, and it is the owner's reported exhaustion, MEASURED: three times, in one day, by the same seat, in the same way. The gate does not fix the habit; it makes the habit VISIBLE. AN INSTRUMENT CORRECTION, MINE: frame.py's self-test uses the STANDARD A2 LEVI as su(3)_colour, NOT derived(floor); both give dim Z = 16 so B958's dimension-only condition SURVIVES, but any finer test must use the floor's, and conjugacy of the two is CONSISTENT WITH, not PROVED BY, the equal dimension -- comment added at the call site so the next user is not misled by a self-test that passes for a possibly-coincidental reason. WHAT DID NOT CHANGE: the SM verdict is unchanged in substance, being sharpened (three leads collapse to one operation), given a mechanism, and scoped in one phrase; no Phase A finding threatens it. One genuine threat named and carried: L132's vacuity holds exactly where the object IS and dies exactly where a phenomenology with extra vector-like matter would have to go -- which threatens a comfort, not the verdict, but is the right shape of warning. And L137 does NOT undermine L138: V6 shows B969's invariants are the GAUGE-INVARIANT ones, the disc squarefree kernel {7,11} surviving the Q*-gauge while coefficient supports do not.
